ModMetaData.name: [1001]Gene Spawn
ModMetaData.author: papercrane1001
ModMetaData.description:
Spawns random genes on all generated pawns... and I mean all of them. By default each humanlike pawn gets about 2 random genes (±1 a third of the time, ±2 a tenth of the time), split between xenogenes and germline genes. Out of the box it will not look at dependencies, it will not look at cosmetic vs functional, and it will not respect fixed xeno- or endo-types.
Everything is adjustable under Options > Mod settings > Gene Spawn: - Average number of genes and how often it goes ±1 / ±2 - Xenogene vs germline gene chance - Whether your own pawns, other pawns, or both are affected - Optional rules: skip duplicates, respect gene conflicts, require prerequisite genes, allow archite genes - A searchable gene blacklist
Like my mod? Donate at: https://ko-fi.com/papercrane1001
I use the MIT license: https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT which mostly says that if you use my code, please give me credit. I used SpawnThoseGenes for learning about GeneDefs and Quarry for learning about settings menus.
GitHub at: https://github.com/papercrane1001/-1001-GeneSpawn
Version 1.1.0
Compatible with 1.6 and 1.7.
CE compatible as long as all your gene mods are compatible.
